meta.title: Vendors cannot see other competing vendors invited to the Request for Best Offer
gaps: Assert that Vendor A's participant or details widget contains no visibility of Vendor B's invitation; the case does not name Vendor B and no catalog assertion can generically verify competitor-invitation absence.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Assert that Vendor A's participant or details widget contains no visibility of Vendor B's invitation; the case does not name Vendor B and no catalog assertion can generically verify competitor-invitation absence.

steps.note: Provide the required event title before publishing.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Invite Vendor A and Vendor B as required by the scenario.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published event page.
Open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor representing Vendor A.
Open the event overview/details view where participant visibility would be exposed.
Confirm Vendor A is on the event details view.
Open Vendor A's RFQ bidding panel.
Verify Vendor A sees its own quote submission control.
Verify the vendor's own bidding prompt and required terms are visible.
